notes.title: Frutiger Space Network Test Announcement
notes.content:
🫧Frutiger Space Network Test!
Hey Meeples!ːsteamhappyː The wait is finally over, the Frutiger Space Playtest is launching on July 24th at 9:00 PM (CEST)!
I’m so excited to finally see the game come to life with you all filling up the lobbies!

The playtest will be open to everyone!

To request access, just click a button when it goes live and you're in.
Access isn’t available yet, it will be starting on the date above.

Psst... Don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t already, it really helps!
[hr][/hr]🎁 Exclusive Discord Playtester Role
Got feedback? Bug reports? Cool ideas?
By sending anything, whether a bug report or suggestion, you’ll earn the exclusive Playtester role on our Discord as a thank you for helping shape the game.

Join the Discord if you'd like to chat with other playtesters!

Follow on TikTok | Instagram | YouTube for new updates!

Wishlist Frutiger Space



Thank you so much for your support, see you in game soon!
